sources.articleTitle: Defisit APBN Tembus Rp379,3 T per Oktober 2026, Ini Posisi Terbarunya
Menkeu Suahasil: Belanja APBN Tembus Rp2.997 T per Oktober 2026
Menkeu: Defisit APBN per Oktober 2026 "on track", capai 1,47 persen
Produksi Bijih Nikel Antam Tembus 12,16 Juta Ton per September 2026

headline: Indonesia Reports State Budget Performance Through October 2026
metaDescription: Government reports indicate state budget deficit at 1.47 percent through October 2026, while PT Antam Tbk records significant nickel production levels.
aiSummaryBullets: The Ministry of Finance reported a budget deficit of Rp379.3 trillion as of October 2026.
State spending reached Rp2,997.2 trillion by October 2026, representing 78 percent of the annual budget.
PT Antam Tbk reached a total nickel ore production volume of 12.16 million tons as of September 2026.
aiContextParagraph: The Indonesian government recently released its fiscal data for the period ending in October 2026, detailing the nation's budget management and spending progress. Ministry of Finance officials, including Suahasil Nazara, stated that the current budget deficit remains on track at 1.47 percent. State revenue has demonstrated growth of 23.9 percent, with the government actively working toward a revenue collection target of Rp590 trillion. Meanwhile, total state expenditures have hit Rp2,997.2 trillion, which accounts for 78 percent of the total planned budget, with a stated focus on accelerating funding for public welfare programs. Parallel to these fiscal reports, industrial output data shows that PT Antam Tbk has achieved a production volume of 12.16 million tons of nickel ore through September 2026, highlighting performance in a key natural resource sector that contributes to the broader national economic landscape.
